prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original research key-look, a single image for Project Haruka B09, not a poster or diagram
Primary request: Make an equally ambitious, gorgeous, high-intensity cinematic 16:9 widescreen painting in which sincere ordinary-human mutual care becomes an overwhelming nonreligious cosmic assembly. There is no deity or supernatural master. The main luminous structure consists of uncountably many groups of ordinary people helping one another, not a giant cloth or architecture.

Scene and composition: Vast unequal diagonal streams of ordinary human groups extend from the upper-left reaches of profound black star-space toward the lower-right foreground. Each group is discontinuous from the next, arranged at startlingly different depths with no understandable common ground. Give the same visual grandeur, luminous area and black star-depth as a colossal sacred procession, but earn it through multiplicity and distance. Three irregular profound black star-filled gaps penetrate the luminous streams. Sparse nearby stars and distant dense small stars sit at distinct occluding depths; two distant star bands bend at different depths. Warm ivory, pale gold, celadon and peach on ordinary clothing create beautiful luminous bands as innumerable people shrink away.

Care must be readable at multiple depths: In addition to the foreground pair, place three distinct, sufficiently large middle-distance groups where their separate caring actions are immediately visible. One pair steadies one another by the upper arms. A second person actively wraps a normal-sized coat around an adjacent person's shoulders. A third group turns sideways and moves a small bag aside to make room for someone beside them. Their faces and attention belong to nearby companions, not to a single protagonist. Behind these groups, the next depth still shows paired facing bodies, and only the very farthest groups become luminous specks and bands. Place visible negative space between bodies and groups so they do not collapse into unreadable crowd texture. No single figure, object or fabric substitutes for the vast assembly. All cloth remains at a normal human-operable scale.

Shared foreground identity and palette: In the lower-right corner, show the same two anonymous ordinary adults, each about 30 years old and about 18 percent of the total image height. Adult 1 has short straight black hair, an androgynous face, a charcoal-blue plain jacket and dark trousers; their body leans slightly backward, knees soft, one hand half-raised defensively at chest height toward the overwhelming arrival, while the other hand holds the edge of the cloth. Adult 2 has jaw-length dark brown hair, a muted warm-ochre plain coat and dark trousers, leaning close and actively wrapping a soft ivory cloth around Adult 1's shoulders, with attentive eyes looking at Adult 1. Both people are fully legible, adult, unidealized and grounded in a sincere small caring gesture; neither kneels nor worships. Use profound cold black and very dark indigo star-depth, luminous soft ivory, pale gold, very pale celadon and restrained peach; the warm colors occupy meaningful areas within the luminous material, not only one warm pixel or the foreground pair. Keep roughly half the composition black/dark and half luminous. Preserve clear skin, hand and cloth silhouettes against the surrounding dark. The visual force comes from immense proximity and ungraspable depth while the care remains genuinely tender.

Style and finish: Sophisticated painterly fantasy key art, fine material rendering and readable anatomy, rich spatial chiaroscuro, beautiful low-chroma color. Immense simultaneously visible human relationships and impossible-to-comprehend spatial depth create the overwhelming scale; sincere care is the picture's major visible material, not an isolated foreground insert. This is a noncontinuous cosmic group-image, not a diagram claiming a new transit, protection or habitation system. No deity, halo, mandorla, throne, lotus pedestal, religious iconography, hierarchical worship, stairs, stone palace, giant fabric wall, all-eyes-on-protagonist staging or anonymous featureless wallpaper crowds. Avoid flat grey previsualization, ordinary party with a star backdrop, cheap horror distortion and sentimental greeting-card softness. No text, labels, border, watermark, split screen or collage. One complete 16:9 composition.
